_doc: Default analysis regions of the Nocturne key shots for Tools/qa (format: see the docstring of Tools/qa/qa_common.py).
Source: MASTER_PROMPT 14.10 per-beat table (banding regions) and 14.7 H1 (6) (encode-test views KS04 sky, KS10 abyss, KS16 wall,
KS17 plaza). Rects are frame fractions [x0, y0, x1, y1] (top-left origin, 'units': 'frac'), valid at 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9.
Beat 3 'abyss rect (x 0.1-0.9, y -0.9..-0.2)': x as a frame fraction, y in NDC -> frac y 0.60-0.95; the same rect for the
other look-down shots (KS09, KS12, KS13). The aliasing regions of 14.10 (cables, rails, blade strokes, ribs, LED grids) are thin-line
probes whose positions depend on the built geometry: each beat builder adds them (report.json 'regions' or an entry here) when
its geometry exists; neon masks (clipped / isolated-pixel exclusions) likewise ('exclude').

Q1 (Phase 3 graybox gate): every banding rect re-placed on the gradient it names in the built geometry (the D-025 abyss rect y 0.60-0.95 lies on the deck in KS09 / KS10 / KS12; the sky rects of KS00-KS04 / KS07 lay on facades and blades; KS16 spanned panel seams; KS17 / KS18 held the koi; KS19 the tenement roof edge). Rects avoid rails, cross bridges, layer lines, the upper tube and the koi at 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9 (checked on QA/captures/graybox01*). KS03 and KS19 have no sky: their darkest smooth gradient (alley wall, tenement wall) is the region. Thresholds unchanged.

TQ 2026-11-16 (requests of GE and PA after GE's masses, checked on QA/captures/PA_r03): KS04 sky to y 0.22 (the canyon skybridge starts at 0.26), KS05 cloud y 0.05-0.36 (the beam at 0.37-0.45), KS13 abyss inside the glass strip between its inner members and above the light line, KS17 plaza clear of the bollards; KS07 sky_above_gulf and KS15 crown_gap_sky dropped (face B and the east block now fill those frames: no sky or soffit gradient left); seq_enc_beat07_goal (a static clip at the KS19 pose) and seq_enc_beat01_wall carry the KS19 / KS00 wall rects.

FX 2026-11-16 (QA-2, QA-6; checked on QA/captures/lookv2_01, lookv2_01_ksv1, graybox01): KS00 mouth_glow moved off the signs and lamps of the far alley onto the wet floor that mirrors the mouth glow (x 0.487-0.527, y 0.493-0.572, BandScore 0.20); KS03 alley_wall_dark onto the dark alley wall alone (x 0.01-0.10, clear of the boulevard towers; BandScore 0.15); KS17 plaza gated on coherent visible steps only ("gate": "steps": the granite paving's own plateaus and the lamp-streak edges are not banding; a quantisation contour still fails). Thresholds unchanged.

QA 2026-11-21 (fix wave C19 / C47; checked on QA/captures/p4_01 and p4_01_1610 / _219): "units": "frac169" = a 16:9 frame fraction projected to the image's aspect at the same vFOV (qa_common.scale_xy), so one rect stays on its subject at 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9. Every encode clip carries the rects of the key shot it ends on (match lists). KS10 abyss [0.40, 0.04, 0.51, 0.22] (AT's request, D-037 19). KS12 abyss moved onto the visible drop between the deck members, left of the traffic river [0.41, 0.53, 0.51, 0.68] (the old rect lay on T3's windows and the tube). KS16 wall_panel on one open panel of the wall field between its seams, above the LED dot grid and left of the cyan bars [0.14, 0.53, 0.20, 0.62] (the old 16:10 / 21:9 rects sat on the lobby canopy, the 16:9 one on the dot grid). Thresholds unchanged. enc_beat05_crown: the dark gap between the two canopies left of the crown ring [0.42, 0.0, 0.48, 0.11] (encode clip only, not KS15's gate); enc_trans_mouth: the fogged dark alley wall left of the mouth [0.04, 0.10, 0.20, 0.60] (checked on the p4_01 CRF-23 decodes).
